questions.question: How many days did God take to create the world?
questions.explanation: God created the world in six days and rested on the seventh (Genesis 1–2).

questions.question: Who was the first man created by God?
questions.explanation: God formed Adam from the dust of the ground (Genesis 2:7).

questions.question: How many books are in the Bible?
questions.explanation: The Bible contains 66 books — 39 in the Old Testament and 27 in the New Testament.

questions.question: Who built the ark to survive the great flood?
questions.explanation: God commanded Noah to build the ark to save his family and pairs of every animal (Genesis 6).

questions.question: In which city was Jesus born?
questions.explanation: Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea, fulfilling the prophecy of Micah 5:2.

questions.question: Who baptized Jesus?
questions.explanation: John the Baptist baptized Jesus in the Jordan River (Matthew 3:13–17).

questions.question: How many disciples did Jesus choose?
questions.explanation: Jesus chose twelve disciples to follow him and carry on his ministry (Matthew 10:1–4).

questions.question: Who wrote most of the New Testament letters?
questions.explanation: The Apostle Paul authored at least 13 of the 27 New Testament books.

questions.question: What was the first miracle Jesus performed?
questions.explanation: Jesus turned water into wine at a wedding in Cana — his first recorded miracle (John 2:1–11).

questions.question: On what mountain did Moses receive the Ten Commandments?
questions.explanation: God gave Moses the Ten Commandments on Mount Sinai (Exodus 19–20).
